name: Canvas
description: MOSS Code's start page: every session as a block on a canvas, the lines between them, and a new session from the + button.

places.title: Where you moved blocks
places.description: Kept by the canvas when you drag a block, so it stays there. Clear it to put every block back in its own place.

seen.title: When you last saw the canvas
seen.description: Kept by the canvas so it can mark what crossed between sessions while it was closed.
